comment: 封面画风预设。可自由增删改，脚本不写死任何风格。key 是 --style 的取值；label 用于展示和存档；direction 是交给文本模型的画风方向，它会据此扩写成完整的英文图片提示词。

neon-3d.label: 深色霓虹 3D
neon-3d.direction: glossy 3D render on a near-black background, saturated neon accent colors with emissive glow, volumetric light, polished reflective surfaces

flat-vector.label: 浅底平面矢量海报
flat-vector.direction: flat vector illustration on an off-white background, no photorealism, no 3D shading, no glow, three or four solid colors plus one accent, uniform line weight, large simple shapes

iso-blueprint.label: 等距蓝图线稿
iso-blueprint.direction: technical blueprint drawing in isometric projection, deep navy background, a single cyan ink in thin uniform line weight, fine construction grid, no photorealistic materials, no glow

paper-print.label: 纸质孔版印刷
paper-print.direction: risograph print on warm off-white paper, two or three matte spot inks with slight misregistration, visible paper grain, no glow, no digital gradients

minimal-mono.label: 极简瑞士海报
minimal-mono.direction: minimal Swiss editorial poster, near-white background, one accent color plus black, very few elements, generous negative space, exact geometric primitives, flat fills

hand-drawn.label: 手绘墨线水彩
hand-drawn.direction: hand-drawn ink line work with loose watercolor wash on warm neutral paper, visible pen texture and slight imperfection, muted natural pigments, no digital gradients
